{{Otheruses|Home Fleet}}
The '''Home Fleet''' of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] [[Blockade/Legends|besieged]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exodo II]] and the remains of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Boreleo]] following the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Battle over Exodo II|battle]] against the rival Imperial forces of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] from Fel's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']], and strictly monitored the area around Exodo II by deploying a thousand Imperial [[Sienar Sentinel]] [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ships]] and six [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] task forces, with a hundred [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] crew, including one of multiple [[Chiss Star Destroyer]]s from the [[Empire of the Hand]], firing at the remains of Boreleo, to which Daala and her forces had retreated. Meanwhile, three Home Fleet [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] crews monitored every cubic [[Meter/Legends|meter]] between the target zone of Boreleo and the cordon perimeter.
